claims.disproof_condition: Upgrade when a named customer or module maker discloses TFLN-based product shipments; downgrade if next-gen CPO/transceiver sockets standardize on silicon MRM or InP EML without TFLN adoption (watch OFC announcements and NVIDIA/module-maker BOM disclosures).
claims.statement: HyperLight self-reports a patented TFLN Chiplet platform in volume manufacturing for scale-up and scale-out (datacenter/AI) applications, with modulator performance up to 145 GHz bandwidth and 448 Gbps per lane. This gives tech:tfln_platform its first supplier edge. Honesty: supplier self-report with no named customer; TFLN competes with silicon MRM (TSMC COUPE path already in graph) for next-gen modulators — TFLN winning sockets is NOT evidenced; substrate upstream (TFLN wafers, e.g., unnamed here) remains a separate unknown layer.
